      "evidence": "Changes the `bitcoin` wrapper process execution in `src/bitcoin.cpp` and `src/util/exec.cpp`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes `bitcoin.exe` wrapper process management on Windows to wait for the child process and forward exit codes instead of immediately terminating. This improves platform coverage for multiprocess binaries and re-enables functional tests on Windows."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to `test_framework.py` and test scripts only follow the wrapper fix by re-enabling previously skipped tests.",

      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Does not change testing infrastructure itself; the test diffs simply re-enable tests on Windows that were blocked on the wrapper bug."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the `bitcoin` wrapper executable (`src/bitcoin.cpp`).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes the `bitcoin` wrapper tool on Windows so that external callers and scripts can track child process completion and inspect exit codes."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `util::ExecVp` in `src/util/exec.cpp`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes `util::ExecVp` on Windows by switching from `_execvp` to `_spawnvp` with `_cwait`, ensuring child processes are waited on and error reporting uses POSIX `generic_category()`."
    }
